SOLVES 50/50 (used last on this copy). Best valid locked = copy of R1623 (reward 1.474).

STRUCTURE THAT WORKS: 2 columns only. Feed column splits a worthless light T (C3/C4/C5, $0) from B; B column splits BT = C6-paraffin blend (~$1060M/yr) from worthless heavies BB. ALL revenue is the C6-paraffin blend (2,2-DMB+2-MP+3-MP+nC6). Blends pay NO premium, so don't chase pure grades. Any 3rd column (T-split or BB-split) added $600M+ cost for $0 revenue — never worth it.

KEY TRADE: the feed column's reflux sets the nC5 leak into B (too low -> nC5 contaminates BT, blend drops <95%); the B column's reflux/stages set the MCP impurity (~4% floor, MCP bp 345K sits inside the C6 window). BT has ~4% MCP — the binding constraint — so cant shrink columns much further without breaking 95%.

CROSS-AGENT FINDINGS: R1623 (36/2.6/2.6 + 36/4.0/4.0) = 1.474 beats R1621 (36/2.5 + 40/4.5)=1.454 (cheaper B column wins despite slightly lower rev). My 38/2.6+B40/4.5=1.433, 40/3/3+B40/4.5=1.344, 32/2/2 fails (BT 94%).

DECISION: budget exhausted; R1623 is the best seen (1.474). Locking it. If a solve becomes available, next probe: B column 32-34 stages at R~3.5 while keeping BT>=95%.
